description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for managing user sessions and messages in a backend API for a chat or session management system. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting sessions, as well as posting messages within sessions. The code integrates with Supabase for data storage and enforces row-level security policies, with detailed diagnostics and environment variable configurations.

methods.name: get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client using environment variables for URL and key, prioritizing the service role key.

methods.name: list_sessions(user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all sessions for the authenticated user.

methods.name: create_session(payload: SessionCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new session for the authenticated user.

methods.name: get_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific session along with its messages.

methods.name: update_session(session_id: str, payload: SessionUpdate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update the title of a specific session.

methods.name: delete_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a session owned by the user.

methods.name: post_message(session_id: str, payload: MessageCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a user message to a session, ensuring at least one file exists, and then returns an assistant stub reply.
